title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・泥道こそ花道

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black stuns the audience into silence as she brute forces her way through the quagmire of a racecourse…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And explodes past the finish line. Her resilience ensnares the hearts of many, and Satono Diamond, who sees her dear friend win, is inspired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next goal is a festival on an international scale—the Japan Cup. Kitasan Black swears to make it a good one with the other powerful athletes at Tokyo Racecourse.
